name: Offline Neural TTS (Kokoro, GPU)
description: A higher-quality neural voice for your whole computer, running entirely on your device — and GPU-accelerated where the device has a GPU. A Provider app: put it in your Providers folder, assign it to Text → speech in Settings → AI models, and every app that speaks uses it. Eight voices, built on Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0), whose fp16 weights arrive once as a hash-pinned 163 MB download. It runs on WebGPU when the device exposes one and falls back to CPU (WebAssembly) otherwise — faster on a real GPU, and it still works everywhere. Its tiny sibling, Offline Neural Text to Speech (KittenTTS), stays the instant, always-CPU option; pick one in Settings.

say.detail: The voice is synthesised here, offline — nothing is sent anywhere, and nothing is saved. The first time, the 163 MB voice has to download.
